description: This file defines data models related to orders in a restaurant application, including item selections, order details, and enumerations for fulfillment, payment methods, and order statuses.

classes.name: ItemSelection
classes.description: Represents a customized item in a shopping cart, including options like portion, add-ons, spice level, and quantity.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Encapsulates the details of a customer order, including items, fulfillment type, payment method, status, timestamps, and optional delivery address.

methods.name: lineTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total price for this item selection based on item price and quantity.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of this ItemSelection with optional modifications.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of this Order with optional modifications.
